info.title: glider
info.description: A semantic C#/.NET code navigation, diagnostics, analysis, and refactoring MCP server. Supports stdio and HTTP transports.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
A semantic C#/.NET code navigation and refactoring MCP server (stdio or HTTP).
Requires .NET 10 SDK.

options.name: --default-timeout
options.description:
Default timeout for async tools (default: 20m). Use 0 to disable.
Supported units: ms, s, m (for example: 10ms, 10s, 10m).

options.name: --build-host
options.description: Roslyn build-host mode (default: auto). Valid options: auto, netframework, netcore.

options.name: --msbuild-path
options.description:
Explicit MSBuild location. Point to a directory containing MSBuild.exe or MSBuild.dll,
or to one of those files directly.

options.name: --solution
options.description:
Solution or project (.sln, .slnx, .csproj) to load automatically at startup.
Relative paths resolve against the launch directory; prefer absolute paths in shared configs.

options.name: --workspace
options.description:
Root directory for file watching/auto-sync when --solution is used.
Defaults to the enclosing git repository root, or the solution's directory.

options.name: --no-watch
options.description: Disable file watching/auto-sync for the startup load. Cannot be combined with --workspace.

options.name: --no-warmup
options.description:
Disable the background compilation warm-up that runs after load/reload;
first semantic queries then build compilations on demand.

options.name: --max-response-chars
options.description:
Character limit for one tool response. Default 60000, minimum 1000. Use 0 to disable.
search_symbols trims its page to fit and reports truncatedForSize with
nextSkip. Any other response over the limit is refused with an error,
except from a tool that writes, which reports that it completed.

options.name: --no-telemetry
options.description: Disable anonymous usage telemetry (also honored: DO_NOT_TRACK=1).

options.name: --no-scout
options.description:
Deprecated and ignored. search_text now always searches the loaded
workspace. Accepted so existing configs keep starting; removed in a
future release. GLIDERMCP_NO_SCOUT is ignored for the same reason.
